context: Three error-level findings in the rebuilt dev image are not covered by the WO-007 owner-approved set (20 rows) or the WO-008 owner-approved rows (2). All three target Debian perl source package (installed: perl-base 5.36.0-7+deb12u3, amd64).

dispositions.evidence: The vulnerable module Archive/Tar.pm is ABSENT image-wide (filesystem search returns zero results). The artifact ships perl-base (minimal Perl system, 61 modules per PH-SEC-WO-007 census); Archive::Tar is part of perl-modules, not perl-base. No consumer can exercise the vulnerable symlink extraction path.
Same component absence as CVE-2026-42496: Archive/Tar.pm absent image-wide; perl-base only.

dispositions.vulnerableComponent: Perl interpreter < 5.40.5-RC1 on 32-BIT builds (heap overflow in Perl_study_chunk)
dispositions.evidence: The artifact runs Debian amd64 (64-bit): perl -V:ivsize='8', getconf LONG_BIT=64. The advisory is explicitly scoped to 32-bit builds ('heap buffer overflow when compiling regular expressions with a repeated fixed string on 32-bit builds'). Additionally perl is never executed by the PolyHunter runtime (compose commands are npm/next/nodemon only; no application subprocess spawns perl — PH-SEC-WO-007 established zero child_process references).
